title: Injectivity of geometric stalk evaluation
statement: Let $K$ be a field, $K^{sep}$ its separable closure, $\Omega$ its algebraic closure, $p$ its geometric point [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], and $\mathbb G_m$ its units sheaf [def-sc-gm-torsor]. Suppose an additive homomorphism $f:(\mathbb G_m)_p\to (K^{sep})^\times$ [def-sc-galois-units-cohomology] satisfies the evaluation formula on every unit germ: its image embedded into $\Omega$ is the value of the representing unit at the geometric lift. Then $f$ is injective. This conclusion has no Galois action or equivariance clause.

proof.text: Use the proved Mathlib theorem Point.toPresheafFiber_jointly_surjective₂ to represent both stalk elements by units z₁ and z₂ on the same pointed etale neighbourhood (X,x). Equality of their f-images and the two evaluation formulas imply equality of their pulled-back section values in Ω. Cancel the ring equivalence ΓSpecIso to obtain equality in Γ(Spec Ω, top).

Use the existing proved source-library lemma Scheme.discreteTopology_of_etale_of_unique (WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.Sites.PointFunctions) to make the singleton of x(default) an open U. Scheme.exists_pointSmallEtale_fiber_ofOpens from that module lifts x to a point y on Y = Etale.ofOpens X U, with refinement g:Y -> X and p.fiber.map g y = x. Y is nonempty and subsingleton. The existing proved source-library lemma Scheme.isField_of_etale_of_subsingleton (WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.Sites.Hilbert90Etale) makes Γ(Y,top) a field, so the ring homomorphism y.appTop into Γ(Spec Ω,top) is injective.

Pullback of functions along y followed by g equals pullback along x by Hom.comp_appTop and the pointed refinement equality. Thus injectivity of y.appTop makes the underlying values of the two restricted units equal. Units.ext, injectivity of Additive.toMul and ULift.ext give equality of their restricted sections of Gm. Apply Mathlib Point.toPresheafFiber_eq_iff′ with Y,g,y to conclude equality of the original germs.

lean.statement:
theorem etale_units_stalk_evaluation_injective (K : Type u) [Field K] :
    let Ω := AlgebraicClosure K
    let S := Spec (.of K)
    let p := pointSmallEtale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)))
    ∀ f : (p.sheafFiber (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj S.gmSheaf →+
        Field.galoisUnitsTopRep K,
      (∀ (X : S.Etale) (x : p.fiber.obj X) (z : S.gmSheaf.obj.obj (op X)),
        algebraMap (SeparableClosure K) Ω
            (Additive.toMul (f (p.toPresheafFiber X x S.gmSheaf.obj z)) :
              (SeparableClosure K)ˣ) =
          (ΓSpecIso (.of Ω)).hom
            (x.left.appTop ((Additive.toMul z.down : Γ(X.left, ⊤)ˣ) : Γ(X.left, ⊤)))) →
      Function.Injective f
